chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Abu al-Jahm Harun ibn al-Jahm, from Hafs ibn Umar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his Family) was asked about the community of his nation, so he said: The community of my nation are the people of truth, even if they were few.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْحَقِّ: The people of truth, denoting those who adhere to the correct doctrine and path.
key_terms.أُمَّتِي: My nation, referring to the followers of Prophet Muhammad.
key_terms.جَمَاعَة: Community or group, specifically referring to the collective body of the Prophet's followers.
key_terms.وَإِنْ قَلُوا: Even if they are few, highlighting that numerical minority does not negate validity.

ai.seo_question: Who constitutes the true community (Jama'ah) of the Prophet according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Mani al-Akhbar*, this hadith clarifies the Shia concept of the 'true community' by prioritizing doctrinal fidelity over numerical strength, a key distinction from other schools that often equate the majority with correctness. It underscores the principle that the path of truth (*Ahl al-Haqq*) may remain distinct and minority-held until the Day of Judgment, reinforcing the legitimacy of the Ahl al-Bayt's followers even in times of political dominance by opposing groups.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Abi Abdillah, from his father, from Abu’l-Jahm, Harun bin Jahm, from Hafs bin Umar, from Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him, that he said:

The Messenger of Allah, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, was asked about the community of this nation, so he said: The community of my nation are the people of truth, even if they were a few.
